name: SPECT 空力公式 Mira frameset
why_interesting: The retained CNY 6,999 observation matches the China Cycle launch price for the Mira frame, fork and integrated-cockpit package; the pictured show build is not treated as a standard complete bike.

facts.frame: SPECT Mira T1100 + M90 carbon aero road frameset
facts.frame_construction: Aero carbon frame with T47×86 bottom bracket, UDH and electronic-only shifting compatibility
facts.frame_weight_basis: Upper end of the 900–940 g quoted launch range; size, finish, hardware inclusion and weighing method are not stated, and no delivered production frame has been independently weighed
facts.cockpit: Matching integrated cockpit included in the reported launch package
facts.drivetrain_compatibility: Electronic shifting only; no drivetrain is included with the frameset package
facts.stiffness_evidence: Independent launch reporting says SPECT judged the development Mira frame too stiff and was softening the lay-up before delivery; this is exact development-state evidence, not a numeric or delivered-production-frame test
facts.regional cockpit reference: Current Cycle Gears retailer reference: 55 mm rise, 75 mm reach, 120 mm drop, −13° stem, 22 mm clamp stack. Regional reference only; the retained selected package remains unverified.

missing: Production-revision maximum tire clearance: current exact sources conflict between 32C and 35 mm rear / 38 mm front claims
Delivered-frame weight and stiffness verification for a frozen production revision
Current mainland stock, final checkout conditions and domestic warranty route
source_note: The CNY 6,999 evidence is for the frame, fork and matching-handlebar package. The show bike is illustrative. The 32C current-retailer limit conflicts with independent launch reporting of 35 mm rear / 38 mm front fit, so the catalog preserves maximum clearance as unknown rather than selecting one claim.

enrichment_reviews.scope: Exact current source additions; existing observations, conflicts and collection dates retained.

en.title: SPECT Mira frameset: price record, package and tire-limit conflict
en.description: Separate the Mira’s dated frame price from a complete-build estimate, and check production revision, cockpit inclusion and conflicting tire limits.
en.opening: The recorded ¥6,999 Mira price dates to August 8, 2026; it is not a current complete-bike quote. The retained 900–940 g frame claim lacks a stated size, finish and hardware basis. Tire-clearance sources also disagree: 32C versus 35 mm rear and 38 mm front. Confirm the exact production revision before choosing parts.
en.buyer_checks: Obtain written clearance guidance for the supplied revision; confirm cockpit dimensions and every included part; check electronic-drivetrain compatibility. Current mainland stock, final price and domestic warranty route remain unverified.
en.guide_text: Compare rideable totals with our frameset-versus-complete-bike cost guide.

zh-Hans.title: SPECT Mira 车架组：价格记录、套餐与胎容争议
zh-Hans.description: 区分 Mira 的历史车架价格与整车估算，核对量产版本、车把包含范围及相互冲突的胎容信息。
zh-Hans.opening: 已记录的 Mira ¥6,999 价格来自 2026 年 8 月 8 日，并非当前整车报价。保留的 900–940 g 车架重量说法未说明尺码、涂装及五金口径。胎容来源也不一致：32C 与后轮 35 mm、前轮 38 mm。选配件前，先确认实际交付的量产版本。
zh-Hans.buyer_checks: 取得对应版本的书面胎容说明；确认车把尺寸及全部包含配件；核对电子变速兼容性。目前大陆库存、成交价及国内保修渠道仍未核实。
zh-Hans.guide_text: 用车架自组与整车成本指南比较可骑行总成本。

de.title: SPECT Mira: Preisstand, Lieferumfang und widersprüchliche Reifenlimits
de.description: Trenne den datierten Rahmenpreis von der Aufbaukalkulation und prüfe Produktionsversion, Cockpit und offene Reifenfreiheit.
de.opening: Der dokumentierte Mira-Preis von ¥6.999 stammt vom 8. August 2026 und ist kein aktuelles Komplettradangebot. Bei der gespeicherten Gewichtsangabe von 900–940 g fehlen Größe, Lackierung und Kleinteilumfang. Auch die Reifenangaben widersprechen sich: 32C gegenüber 35 mm hinten und 38 mm vorn. Kläre zuerst die gelieferte Produktionsversion.
de.buyer_checks: Schriftliche Reifenfreigabe für diese Version verlangen; Cockpitmaße und Lieferumfang bestätigen; elektronische Schaltkompatibilität prüfen. Bestand, Endpreis und Garantieabwicklung in Festlandchina bleiben ungeklärt.
de.guide_text: Vergleiche fahrfertige Kosten mit unserem Ratgeber zu Rahmenset und Komplettrad.
